objects.name: Analytic 2261
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) operator/service account being granted elevated Windows privileges without a corresponding administrative logon event, or a process crash in an Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor application immediately followed by a new process inheriting elevated token privileges. Documented in PIPEDREAM's LAZYCARGO component, which drops and exploits a known vulnerable ASRock driver to elevate credentials. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
